Lett. 133, 071601 (2024), arXiv:2312.14913. https://arxiv.org/ abs/2312.14913 SUPPLEMENTAL MATERIAL The Supplement establishes the monodromy exchange law, derives its fixed-aω, small-Mω and low-frequency consequences, and documents the numerical reconstruction and flux normalization. Each equation is introduced where its definitions and derivation are discussed. All scripts and data are available at [25]. S1. THE EXCHANGE LAW: SETTING AND PROOF. Setting. For integer s the radial Teukolsky equation has regular singular points at r = r±, with exponents {−s − iϵ±, iϵ±}, and an irregular singular point at r = ∞, as in the monodromy approach to Kerr scattering [26, 27]. Fix a base point r0 > r+ on the real axis.
